1.t: By the fig and the olive ˹of Jerusalem˺

4.t: Indeed, We created humans in the best form
4.tr: Laqad khalaqnal insaana fee ahsani taqweem

5.t: But We will reduce them to the lowest of the low ˹in Hell˺

6.t: except those who believe and do good—they will have a never-ending reward
6.tr: Ill-lal lazeena aamanoo Wa-'amilus saalihaati; falahum ajrun ghairu mamnoon

7.t: Now, what makes you deny the ˹final˺ Judgment

8.t: Is Allah not the most just of all judges
